run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark to time graph composition forward and backward passes
run_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward score benchmark to time forward scoring and backward passes on graphs
run_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark to time gtn.parallel_for execution over a batch
review_time_compose: review the time_compose function which benchmarks gtn.compose and gtn.backward on batches of linear graphs
review_time_forward_score: review the time_forward_score function which benchmarks gtn.forward_score and gtn.backward on batches of graphs
